responsibility: This header implements a type-safe C++ wrapper around libiberty-style splay trees. It owns the typed node structure, comparator and deletion callbacks, splaying and rotations, insertion/replacement, removal, lookup, predecessor/successor search, min/max queries, and non-recursive inorder traversal, exposing a map-like API that stores KEY_TYPE to VALUE_TYPE associations while preserving splay-tree semantics.
same_name_distinction: Implements the typed_splay_tree template itself—a type-safe wrapper around libiberty-style splay trees with lookup/insert/remove and traversal logic—while gcc/typed-splay-tree.cc is just its selftest file.
